value: Your Slack conversations — so what needs your attention can be surfaced, and replies drafted, without opening the app.

guided.why: Credentials are extracted from your already-signed-in Chrome rather than typed, so no token is ever pasted or stored by the framework.
guided.note: The registration itself needs no secret — `env` is empty by design. Do NOT infer 'has a key' from the registration (audit finding 4).
